narrationTexts: I'll survey the codebase for `account_id` usage.
finalText:
**Big but shallow.** `1082` hits across `94` files.

| area | files | why frozen |
|---|---|---|
| [docs/openapi.yaml](docs/openapi.yaml:13) | 1 | public API contract |
| [lib/serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js:8) | 1 | `WIRE` values are wire names |
| [vendor/reporting-sdk](vendor/reporting-sdk/src/client.js:3) | 4 | `npm run vendor:refresh` overwrites |
| `migrations/*.sql` | 12 | applied history, breaks down step |
| repo SQL strings | 25 | DB column is still `account_id` |

Safe today: local vars in 75 service files. The `125` SQL lines need a column migration first.

Next: sign off on internal vars only.
